questions.question: The Somnath Swabhiman Parv commemorates 1,000 years since what event?

options.text: First recorded attack on Somnath Temple

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**First recorded attack on Somnath Temple.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Somnath Swabhiman Parv is observed from January 8 to 11 in Somnath, Gujarat, commemorating 1,000 years since the first recorded attack on the historic Somnath Temple.**
 
• The first recorded major attack on the Somnath temple was in January **1026 CE**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Event Duration: Four-day festival observed annually from January 8–11.**
 
• **Location: Somnath, Gir Somnath district, Gujarat.**
 
• **Spiritual Significance: Somnath Temple is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva.**
 
• **Historical Importance: Commemorates 1,000 years since the first recorded attack on the temple.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The festival celebrates the resilience and cultural heritage of the Somnath Temple over a millennium.**
 
• **The temple has been historically attacked multiple times and rebuilt, symbolizing faith and perseverance.**
 
• **Somnath is a major pilgrimage site, attracting devotees from across India and abroad.**

questions.question: The Pralay missile, whose salvo launch was recently conducted as part of user evaluation trials, is best described as which type of missile system?

options.text: Intercontinental ballistic missile with nuclear warhead

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indigenously developed solid-propellant quasi-ballistic missile.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **DRDO successfully conducted a salvo launch of two Pralay missiles off the coast of Odisha as part of user evaluation trials.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Pralay is an indigenously developed, solid-fuel, quasi-ballistic tactical missile.**
 
• Both missiles followed the intended trajectory and met all mission objectives.
 
• The trials were monitored by tracking sensors of the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur.
 
• The missile is intended for induction into the Indian Army and the Indian Air Force with conventional warheads.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Quasi-Ballistic Missile__

 __
 
• Follows a lower and flatter trajectory than traditional ballistic missiles.
 
• Capable of manoeuvring during flight to evade missile defence systems.
 
• Combines features of ballistic flight with limited in-flight course correction.
 
 
 
• Pralay Missile__
 __
 
• First tested in December 2021.
 
• Employs advanced guidance and navigation systems for high precision.
 
• Can carry different types of conventional warheads against diverse targets.
 
 
 
• Development Agencies__
 
 
• Developed by DRDO’s Research Centre Imarat, Hyderabad.
 
• Supported by multiple laboratories including ARDE, HEMRL and R&DE (Engineers).
 
• Industry partners include Bharat Dynamics Limited and Bharat Electronics Limited.

questions.question: Which of the following rare migratory birds of prey was recently spotted at Mudumalai Tiger Reserve during the 2025–26 winter season?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Eastern Imperial Eagle**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• A rare Eastern Imperial Eagle was sighted at Mudumalai Tiger Reserve in Tamil Nadu during the 2025–26 winter season, confirming the reserve’s importance as a winter refuge for long-distance migratory raptors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Scientific Name: **Aquila heliaca**; Family: Accipitridae; Subfamily: Aquilinae.
 
• Breeds in southeastern Europe, West and Central Asia; migrates south to northeastern Africa, Middle East, and South & East Asia during winter.
 
• Second largest eagle in Europe; wingspan up to 2.14 m; shows reverse sexual dimorphism.
 
• Diet: Predatory bird controlling rodent and small mammal populations; presence indicates a healthy ecosystem.
 
• Conservation Status: **Vulnerable** on the IUCN Red List.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Mudumalai Tiger Reserve is located in Nilgiris district, Tamil Nadu, covering 321 sq. km, and is part of the Nilgiris Biosphere Reserve.
 
• The reserve features open grasslands, forest edges, tall nesting trees, and abundant prey, attracting migratory raptors.
 
• Recent sightings also included the endangered Egyptian vulture alongside the Eastern Imperial Eagle, highlighting ecological significance.
 
• Conservationists warn that increasing tourism could disturb sensitive habitats; sustainable tourism practices are needed to protect wildlife.

questions.question: Rani Velu Nachiyar, celebrated for her bravery and leadership, was born in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1730.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Rani Velu Nachiyar, the first Indian queen to actively resist the British East India Company, was born in 1730 in Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Born in 1730, she was the daughter of the ruler of the Ramnad kingdom and well educated in languages and martial skills.**
 
• Married to the ruler of Sivagangai kingdom, she formed alliances with Hyder Ali and Gopala Nayaker to resist the British.
 
• She formed an army including women soldiers and successfully reclaimed the Sivagangai kingdom after defeating British forces.
 
• Known as **Veeramangai** in Tamil history, she is remembered for bravery, leadership, and anti-colonial resistance; her birth anniversary is observed on 3 January.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Rani Velu Nachiyar__

 __
 
• First Indian queen to wage armed resistance against the British East India Company, decades before the 1857 Revolt.
 
• Trained in martial arts, horse riding, and weaponry from a young age.
 
• Proficient in multiple languages and strategically skilled in forming alliances.
 
 
 
• Sivagangai Kingdom__
 __
 
• Rani Velu Nachiyar married the ruler of Sivagangai and later reclaimed the kingdom after British occupation.
 
• Her military leadership included organizing women soldiers in her army.
 
 
 
• Legacy__
 
 
• Remembered as a symbol of women’s leadership, courage, and anti-colonial resistance.
 
• The title **Veeramangai** honors her valor in Tamil history and cultural memory.

questions.question:
India is set to establish its first public–private partnership (PPP) model medical colleges to expand medical education, strengthen district hospitals, and improve healthcare access in tribal and underserved regions. The foundation stones for the initial colleges were laid in the presence of key health and state officials.

In which Indian state are India’s first PPP-model medical colleges being set up?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India will establish its first PPP-model medical colleges in the tribal districts of Dhar and Betul in Madhya Pradesh to strengthen medical education and district hospitals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Dhar and Betul districts will host the first phase of PPP-model medical colleges in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Under the PPP framework, state provides land while private partners construct academic and clinical infrastructure.
 
• District hospitals will be upgraded as teaching hospitals in accordance with National Medical Commission (NMC) norms.
 
• Four PPP medical colleges are planned in Madhya Pradesh covering Dhar, Betul, Katni, and Panna districts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Objectives of PPP Model Medical Colleges

 
 
• Expand medical education infrastructure in underserved and tribal regions
 
• Improve availability of doctors and medical professionals locally
 
• Encourage private investment in public healthcare education
 
• Support inclusive and equitable healthcare growth in backward areas
 
 
 
• PPP Model Explained
 
 
• State government provides up to 25 acres of land on lease
 
• Private partners construct college buildings, hostels, laboratories, and residential facilities
 
• Hospitals remain under state control to ensure uninterrupted public healthcare
 
 
 
• Significance
 
 
• Represents a historic milestone in India’s medical education and healthcare expansion
 
• Focuses on preventive, promotive, and holistic healthcare alongside curative services

questions.question:
At the 2025 World Blitz Chess Championship held in Doha, a legendary comeback unfolded in the men’s section, while India showcased its rising talent in global chess. The event tested speed, intuition, and nerves under the high-pressure blitz format.

Who won the World Blitz Chess Championship 2025 title?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Magnus Carlsen.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Magnus Carlsen staged a legendary comeback to win the World Blitz Chess Championship 2025 in Doha, claiming his ninth blitz world title.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Carlsen overcame blunders, time trouble, and forfeits in the round-robin stage to win the knockout rounds.
 
• Defeated Nodirbek Abdusattorov in the final to secure his ninth World Blitz Championship title.
 
• Demonstrated exceptional resilience, experience, and mental strength under pressure.
 
• India’s Arjun Erigaisi won bronze, finishing with two medals at the FIDE World Rapid and Blitz Championship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Blitz Chess Format

 
 
• Fast-paced chess where each player has 3–5 minutes plus a small increment per move
 
• Tests speed, intuition, and nerves under pressure
 
 
 
• India’s Performance
 
 
• Arjun Erigaisi won bronze in the men’s rapid and blitz events
 
• Koneru Humpy secured bronze in Women’s Rapid Championship
 
• Highlights India’s growing presence in international chess
 
 
 
• Event Venue & Participation
 
 
• World Rapid and Blitz Chess Championship 2025 held in Doha, Qatar
 
• 252 players participated in the blitz section
 
 
 
• Significance of Carlsen’s Win
 
 
• Ninth World Blitz Championship title for Carlsen
 
• Considered one of his hardest-earned world titles
 
• Showcases enduring dominance and elite-level performance

questions.question: Which state police force has topped the Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System (ICJS) 2.0 National Ranking as per the NCRB’s CCTNS/ICJS Progress Dashboard?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Uttarakhand Police topped the ICJS 2.0 National Ranking, while its SDRF was lauded for exemplary service during Prayagraj Mahakumbh-2025.**

 __

 __

• CCTNS__
 __
 
• Crime and Criminal Tracking Network and Systems used for digitizing police work and criminal records.
 
 
 
• NCRB__
 __
 
• National Crime Records Bureau that releases ICJS and CCTNS performance reports for states and union territories.
 
 
 
• Uttarakhand SDRF__

The correct answer is __**From Paush Purnima to Mahashivratri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **‘Magh Mela 2026’ began in Prayagraj, held annually on the banks of the Sangam from Paush Purnima to Mahashivratri, attracting devotees for ritual bathing and charity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Magh Mela is celebrated on the banks of the confluence (Sangam) of Ganges, Yamuna, and Saraswati in Prayagraj.**
 
• Devotees undertake Kalpavas, living simply on the riverbanks, meditating, bathing at Brahma Muhurat, chanting, and performing charity.
 
• The festival enhances spiritual practices due to the sacredness of the three-river confluence.
 
• Held annually during the month of Magh, it is one of the largest religious gatherings in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Prayagraj Significance__

 __
 
• Formerly known as Allahabad, located in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Home to Triveni Sangam, the confluence of Ganga, Yamuna, and mythical Saraswati.
 
 
 
• Kalpavas Practices__
 __
 
• Devotees take a vow to live austerely along the riverbanks for a month.
 
• Includes early morning bathing, meditation, chanting, and performing charity.
 
 
 
• Timing__
 __
 
• Occurs in the Hindu month of Magh (January–February).
 
• Begins from Paush Purnima and continues until Mahashivratri.
 
 
 
• Religious Importance__
 
 
• Bathing at the Sangam is believed to cleanse sins and enhance spiritual merit.
 
• Donation and charity during the Mela are considered highly meritorious.

questions.question: Which country did India overtake to become the world’s largest rice producer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India surpassed China to become the world’s largest rice producer, achieving 150.18 million tonnes compared to China’s 145.28 million tonnes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Rice production growth attributed to improved irrigation, high-yielding varieties, and better farming practices.**
 
• India now exports rice globally, contributing to higher export earnings.
 
• Union Agriculture Minister unveiled 184 improved crop varieties across 25 field crops, including cereals, pulses, oilseeds, and fodder crops.
 
• New seeds are high-yielding, climate-resilient, and pest-resistant, supporting sustainable agriculture and improving farmer income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Rice Production__

 __
 
• India produced 150.18 million tonnes of rice, becoming the world leader.
 
• China’s rice production stood at 145.28 million tonnes.
 
 
 
• Improved Crop Varieties__
 __
 
• 184 new varieties unveiled covering cereals, pulses, oilseeds, fodder crops, sugarcane, cotton, jute, and tobacco.
 
• Varieties are climate-resilient, pest-resistant, and high-yielding, promoting sustainable agriculture.
 
 
 
• Agricultural Impact__
 __
 
• Enhanced productivity, higher farmer incomes, and strengthened food security.
 
• Represents a technological and innovation-driven phase of India’s agricultural development.
 
 
 
• Global Trade__
 
 
• India’s increased production supports export markets, boosting foreign exchange earnings.
 
• Strategic positioning enhances India’s role as a key global rice supplier.

questions.question: Which state became the first in India to constitute the 8th State Pay Commission even before the expiry of the 7th Pay Commission?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Assam became the first state in India to constitute the 8th State Pay Commission, with the decision announced by Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The 8th State Pay Commission of Assam was constituted before the expiry of the 7th Pay Commission, which ends on January 1, 2026.**
 
• The commission is chaired by **Subhas Das**, former Chief Secretary of Assam.
 
• The Pay Commission will review **salaries, allowances, and pensions** of state government employees.
 
• The revision will consider **inflation, economic conditions, and the state’s fiscal capacity**, potentially leading to faster pay revision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Pay Commission__

 __
 
• A Pay Commission is a government-appointed body that reviews and recommends changes in pay structure of government employees.
 
• It examines salaries, allowances, pensions, and service conditions.
 
• Recommendations are advisory in nature and require government approval.
 
 
 
• Implementation Timeline__
 __
 
• Pay Commission reports generally take around **18 months** to be finalized.
 
• Actual implementation in Assam is expected in **late 2026 or early 2027**.
 
 
 
• Significance of Assam’s Decision__
 
 
• Assam moved ahead of other states and the Centre, where the **8th Central Pay Commission** has not yet been initiated.
 
• The early setup may benefit employees and pensioners through quicker revisions.

questions.question: Which Indian city is continuing its efforts to become the country’s first fully slum-free city due to sustained urban planning and effective housing schemes?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Surat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Surat is on track to become India’s first fully slum-free city through large-scale housing redevelopment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Surat is poised to become India’s first slum-free city.**
 
• The city adopted in-situ redevelopment of slum areas into planned housing complexes.
 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana played a key role in providing permanent housing.
 
• Urban growth has been balanced with inclusive development despite high migration.
 
• **Chandigarh **officially recognized as India's first slum-free city in **October 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Surat Municipal Corporation Strategy__

 __
 
• Focused on permanent housing for all residents.
 
• Ensured access to civic amenities like water, drainage and roads.
 
• Redevelopment allowed residents to stay near workplaces.
 
 
 
• Housing Schemes__
 __
 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana supported affordable housing.
 
• Targeted Economically Weaker Sections and lower-income groups.
 
• Thousands of families rehabilitated into durable homes.
 
 
 
• Urban Significance__
 
 
• Surat is a major textile and diamond-processing hub.
 
• Faces high migrant inflow due to industrial growth.
 
• Emerging as a national model for slum-free urban development.

questions.question: Which country has imposed a 13% value-added tax on condoms and contraceptive drugs from January 1, 2026, as part of efforts to boost its declining birth rate?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **China removed a three-decade-old tax exemption on condoms and contraceptive drugs to encourage higher birth rates.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **China imposed a 13% value-added tax on condoms and contraceptive pills from January 1, 2026.**
 
• The tax exemption had been in place for nearly 30 years.
 
• The move aims to address China’s declining birth rate.
 
• China’s population fell for the third consecutive year in 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Demographic Context__

 __
 
• China has experienced falling birth rates for decades.
 
• Decline attributed to the former one-child policy, urbanisation and rising living costs.
 
• High childcare and education expenses discourage family formation.
 
 
 
• Government Measures__
 __
 
• Childcare subsidies exempted from personal income tax.
 
• Annual childcare subsidy introduced in 2024.
 
• Promotion of positive marriage and childbearing attitudes through policy messaging.
 
 
 
• Policy Significance__
 
 
• Reflects China’s shift towards fertility-friendly economic policies.
 
• Part of broader efforts announced at the Central Economic Work Conference.
 
• Aims to stabilise population decline in the long term.

questions.question: Which public sector telecom operator has rolled out Voice over WiFi (VoWiFi) services nationwide across all telecom circles in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **State-owned telecom operator Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited has launched VoWiFi services across all telecom circles in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **BSNL has rolled out Voice over WiFi (VoWiFi), also known as Wi-Fi Calling, nationwide.**
 
• The service allows users to make and receive calls and messages over Wi-Fi using their existing mobile number.
 
• VoWiFi is an IMS-based service that supports seamless handover between Wi-Fi and mobile networks.
 
• The service is provided free of cost, with no additional charges for Wi-Fi calls.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Voice over WiFi (VoWiFi)__

 __
 
• Enables voice calls and messaging over a Wi-Fi network instead of cellular signals.
 
• Useful in areas with weak mobile coverage such as indoors, basements and remote regions.
 
• Does not require any third-party applications.
 
 
 
• BSNL Network Modernisation__
 __
 
• Part of BSNL’s broader effort to modernise its telecom infrastructure.
 
• Expected to reduce congestion on mobile networks.
 
• Supports usage over BSNL Bharat Fiber as well as other broadband connections.
 
 
 
• Rural Connectivity__
 
 
• Especially beneficial for rural and remote areas with limited mobile signal availability.
 
• Requires only a stable Wi-Fi or broadband connection.
 
• Enhances call clarity and reliability for subscribers.

questions.question: According to an international study, oceans absorbed the most heat on record in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **An international study reported that oceans absorbed the highest amount of heat ever recorded in 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The study, published in Advances in Atmospheric Sciences, found a rise of 23 zettajoules in ocean heat content.**
 
• **This heat gain is equivalent to 37 years of global energy use at 2023 consumption levels.**
 
• **The upper 2,000 metres of oceans recorded the highest heat content, confirming a long-term warming trend.**
 
• **Fastest warming was observed in the Tropical & South Atlantic, North Pacific, and Southern Ocean.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The study involved over 50 scientists from 31 institutions across Asia, Europe and the Americas.**
 
• **Sea-surface temperatures in 2025 were the third highest on record, intensifying floods, droughts and extreme weather.**
